title: Safe Environments
learningGoal: Teach parents how to create physically and emotionally safe environments for children.
microLesson: Safe environments include supervision, hazard reduction, emotional warmth, and predictable routines. Children thrive when they feel protected and supported. Parents can reduce risks by staying attentive and maintaining a calm, structured home.
activity: Identify one safety improvement you can make at home. Reflect on why it matters.
